text: hey where we last were, my power went out. i am resuming the convo now, looks like i sent the last message so we can pick up from there
resolution: Resumed after the user's power outage. Two gaps from before: no grid, and the piece palette wasn't obvious. Root cause on the grid: Scene3D's showGrid prop is a NO-OP (nothing in framework/ or runtime/ draws it), so it never rendered — replaced it with a real tile grid drawn as thin line-box meshes on the active floor, world-anchored and recentred in coarse 4-tile steps (memoized on the snapped centre + level) so a pan doesn't churn the mesh list and a zoomed-out view doesn't spawn thousands of lines; major line every 8 tiles; the grid rides the active floor height so changing levels lifts it. The catalog rail already rendered (the catalog has 7 wall pieces etc.) but read as dark-on-dark text; made it unmistakable with a 'PIECES — <kind> (<n>) · click one, then click the ground' header and larger/brighter/higher-contrast kind tabs + piece chips. Bundles clean (esbuild exit 0). Not runtime-verified by me.
